reason: Akumulasi debit/kredit + valas (debit_a/kredit_a) per akun untuk saldo awal Buku Besar Valas — filter date.$lt=tanggal awal
name: bb_saldo_awal_valas
query:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT G1.* FROM (
    SELECT
      g.tanggal::date AS d,
      jv.account_id,
      k.code AS account_code,
      jv.department_id,
      jv.project_id,
      jv.cost_code_id,
      g.contact_id,
      g.currency_id,
      g.id  AS transaction_id,
      jv.id AS jurnal_id,
      g.type,
      g.nojurnal,
      g.keterangan,
      COALESCE(jv.debit, 0)::numeric  AS debit,
      COALESCE(jv.kredit, 0)::numeric AS kredit,
      COALESCE(jv.debit_a, 0)::numeric  AS debit_a,
      COALESCE(jv.kredit_a, 0)::numeric AS kredit_a
    FROM g_jurnal g
    JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
    JOIN kiraan k    ON k.id = jv.account_id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
  ) G1
  WHERE 1=1 {andWhere}
),
hasil AS (
  SELECT
    f.account_id,
    f.account_code            AS kode_akun,
    k.nama                    AS nama_akun,
    k2.noklasifikasi,
    SUM(f.debit)::numeric(18,2)  AS debit,
    SUM(f.kredit)::numeric(18,2) AS kredit,
    SUM(f.debit_a)::numeric(18,2)  AS debit_a,
    SUM(f.kredit_a)::numeric(18,2) AS kredit_a,
    COUNT(*)                  AS jumlah
  FROM f
  JOIN kiraan k  ON k.id = f.account_id
  JOIN subklas s ON s.id = k.subclassification_id
  JOIN klas k2   ON k2.id = s.classification_id
  GROUP BY f.account_id, f.account_code, k.nama, k2.noklasifikasi
)
SELECT account_id, kode_akun, nama_akun, noklasifikasi, debit, kredit, debit_a, kredit_a, jumlah
FROM hasil
ORDER BY kode_akun {andOrder} {limit}
